skins.name: Fade
skins.description: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.\n\nThis isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

skins.name: Inheritance
skins.description: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. This custom paint job takes inspiration from traditional Chinese porcelain and Delft Blauw art.\n\nA \"family\" heirloom, passed through generations

skins.name: Printstream
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a stark black and white design and finished with pearlescent highlights.\n\nWHITE_1; BLACK_1; PEARLESCENT_1; BOLTACTION_1;

skins.name: Fennec Fox
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with a fennec fox on the barrel. The grip features teal and orange designs.\n\nAll the better to hear you with

skins.name: Epicenter
skins.description: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. This custom paint job gives the appearance of custom machined parts using an anodized finish.\n\nDirect impact

skins.name: Nuclear Threat
skins.description: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

skins.name: Neon Rider
skins.description: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with the image of a deadly biker.\n\nOne part firearm, two parts Trapper Keeper

skins.name: Sugar Rush
skins.description: A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom painted using cotton candy themed colors and various patterns.\n\nPrepare for the crash

skins.name: Slaughter
skins.description: This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.\n\nValeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

skins.name: Fade
skins.description: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. These multicolored gloves have metallic accents.

skins.name: Jawbreaker
skins.description: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. This custom painted USP-S uses high gloss paint and depicts a dog barking from the grip to the silencer. The silencer reads \"GOOD DOGGY\".\n\nI said \"sit\"!

skins.name: Eastern Enigma
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with a metallic silver, black, and blue design.\n\nDon't lose the thread

skins.name: Temukau
skins.description: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A custom paint job in the style of Japanese animation has been applied and depicts a female CT agent fighting against a T-side rush.\n\n\"Stand your ground!\"

skins.name: Fairy Tale
skins.description: Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted with a princess, unicorns, beautiful flowers, and a castle in the distance.\n\n\"Today's gonna be a good day—I can just feel it\"

skins.name: Digital Architect
skins.description: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A multicolored pattern of an isometric grid has been applied.\n\nYou remember pain, I remember victory

skins.name: Wild Lily
skins.description: Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A custom paint job of a blue lily has been hand painted over a purple base.\n\nStop and smell the cordite

skins.name: Vaporwave
skins.description: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with a Greco-Roman statue and other distorted imagery from a bygone era.\n\nFrom a hypnagogic dream

skins.name: Redline
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted using a carbon fiber hydrographic and a dry-transfer decal of a red pinstripe.\n\nNever be afraid to push it to the limit

skins.name: Doppler
skins.description: This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.\n\nGetting lost in its color can prove fatal

skins.name: Cobalt Skulls
skins.description: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching. These blue bias-tape handwraps are printed with skull motifs.
